thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.about-waiting/convinced: I guess you're right. Come back safely.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.about-waiting/entry: I'm not sure I should. I'd rather stick with you until we find what we're looking for.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.about-waiting/unconvinced: Well, I can take care of myself just fine. Carry on.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath-claimed-agree: Alright. Let's go set things right.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath-claimed-worry-stable: And the dwellers ? What happens to them ?
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath-destroyed-agree: Alright. Let's finish what we started.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath-destroyed-worry-overmare: What about the Overmare ? She's the one who kept this a secret in the first place.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath-destroyed-worry-stable: And you're not planning on marching an army into the Stable, are you ?
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/claimed/agreed: Then it's settled. Lead the way - Stable 103 has a homecoming to prepare for.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/claimed/entry: It's done. Sentinel answers to me now. And I made sure the imprint system wouldn't be usable anymore. We go back to Stable 103, I take what's rightfully the Ranger's to give, and your Overmare stands aside - one way or another.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/claimed/press-overmare: It's the only one I've got. A hundred years of her hiding this from her own ponies doesn't exactly earn her the benefit of the doubt, does it ?
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/claimed/worry-overmare: I don't want her dead, if that's what you're asking. I want her out of my way. She steps aside, she gets to live out her days in Junkville like any other pony. She fights me on this, though... I'll do what I have to.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/claimed/worry-stable: They get what Sentinel was always meant to give them - the surface, made survivable, with an army that actually knows how to protect them instead of hiding behind a vault door for another century. That was the whole point, before your Overmares decided otherwise.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/destroyed/agreed: Good. Let's move - the sooner this is behind us, the sooner I stop looking over my shoulder.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/destroyed/entry: Destroying the imprint bought us time, not an ending. Sentinel's still down there, asleep, and so is everything that could tempt somepony else into finishing what I almost did. We need to go to the Stable and put it beyond anypony's reach - the imprint we found here won't be the last chance somepony gets to try.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/destroyed/worry-overmare: She has questions to answer, that much is true. But I'm not looking to put her down for it - I just want Sentinel gone, so nopony else ends up standing where I stood, thinking they're the exception.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.aftermath/destroyed/worry-stable: No army. No invasion. Just making sure the thing that almost got used stays shut down for good. The dwellers won't even know we were there, if I do this right.

bubbles.betrayal: You'd really take it for yourself ? I can't let you.
bubbles.claiming-sentinel: This is it. Sentinel is finally mine.
bubbles.hacked-generator-terminal: I got us admin privileges on that terminal.
bubbles.lets-hack-turret: I'm gonna take over the turret !
bubbles.wants-to-talk: Hey, we should talk about what happens now.

thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.convince-waiting: The path up ahead is dangerous. I must get you there in one piece, else this will all have been for nothing.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.first-time: The Ministry of Arcane Science laboratory. We should look for the control room. It's probably further underground. It might not be a bad idea to turn the power on too.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.sentinel-decision-ask-destroy: Destroy it, once and for all.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.sentinel-decision-ask-imprint: Apply the imprint on me instead.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.sentinel-decision/destroyed: Good. This is the right call. Give me a moment... There. It's done - nopony will ever wake Sentinel up now.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.sentinel-decision/entry: I still think Sentinel shouldn't wake up. Not for me, not for you, not for anypony. What do you want to do about it ?
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.sentinel-decision/refuse-imprint: No. I meant what I said back in that cell. If you go through with it, don't expect me to just stand there.
thornhoof/laboratory/rathian.unconvincing-waiting: I'm not trying to screw you Rathian, I'm just trying to avoid you dying a stupid death !
